mapper.select: SELECT cv.body FROM learning_content lc JOIN content_version cv ON cv.id=lc.published_version_id WHERE lc.id=#{p0} AND lc.content_type='english_article' AND lc.state='published'

SELECT lc.id content_id,cv.phonetic,cv.meaning FROM learning_content lc JOIN content_version cv ON cv.id=lc.published_version_id WHERE lc.content_type='word' AND lc.state='published' AND LOWER(cv.word_term)=#{p0} ORDER BY lc.id LIMIT 1
